verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and PEO product, so offering a 401(k) whose contributions sync with payroll is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a 401(k), retirement plans, or contribution syncing. The nearby items cover other things: recording taxable fringe benefits given outside Justworks, health-insurance provider transitions, and Xero accounting sync, none of which deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll
